quests.title: Just Like a Snowball

dialogue.t: Heh heh... We'll be able to build a snowman soon. Isn't that so exciting, Boss???

Simmer down over there, Anfissa. Making a snowman is serious business. We need every snowball to be the exact right size to make this perfect, and we have to coordinate our efforts completely if we want the best possible result.
But the Angry Bears definitely need more hands on deck to make this happen... At the very least, we need someone who can make us the perfect snowballs...

dialogue.sit: You should know I'm a pro at making snowmen!

dialogue.t: Oh? You sure sound like a confident grownup. Give it a try, then! And if you can give us the perfect snowballs we're looking for, I've got a reward for you!
Remember, the snowballs must all be. Exactly. The. Same. Size...

dialogue.sit: Sorry to disturb you. I've to go now.

dialogue.t: These are absolutely perfect snowballs... All they need is a decoration here and there now. I hereby name this snowman "Big Cheese." From now on, Big Cheese will be a key member of the Angry Bears!
But of course, we still have another two snowmen to build... Would you like to give it a try?

dialogue.sit: Of course! Gotta strike the iron while it's hot!
I'll come back to this later...

dialogue.t: Krylov can decorate and name this second snowman... A personal touch or two is totally acceptable once the snowman is up to standard.
Hmm... I know. I'm gonna call it "Krylov's Number Two."
Um, not bad... Then the only one left would be Anfissa's. Please, if you could continue to help us, that'd be great.
Wow, that snowman is fire! I'm gonna call it... Hmm, I'm gonna call it the "Super Snow Monsta"! Let's go~!
I like that name. It sounds impressive. And now our "Snowman Squad" is also finally complete.
Thank you. This is for you. I'd ask you to join us, but unfortunately, you're a little too old to be a member of the Angry Bears.

quests.description: Help the children produce a snowball of the perfect size
